english.toefl: 79 legacy / 4 new for limited status; 103 legacy / 5 new for full status
english.note: Limited-status minima; full status IELTS 7.5 or DET 135. Below full status requires English placement and possible ESL/reduced load. Tests valid two years before entry. No Essentials, MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Exemptions require a US/approved-country degree or at least two years of study/work there, each within five years of entry; foreign English medium alone does not qualify. TA speaking rules separate; DET cannot establish TA proficiency. Department older exemption language allows English-medium study; current central approved-country restriction differs, so confirm applicability.

applicationFee.note: Current central fee $90 for all applications, overriding older department domestic $70. Waivers limited to eligible domestic categories; international exception only valid exchange agreement with approved fee waiver.

documents: Personal statement addressing development, inclusion and any application concerns
Academic statement, maximum 1,000 words: preparation, interests, faculty fit and goals
Unofficial degree-institution transcripts, degree certificates if needed and English translations
requirements.note: Accepted students join a Pathobiology faculty lab; contact faculty and name interests. Off-cycle review only by prior arrangement with specified advisor. Passport needed before admission; dependents/external funding can require financial proof.

funding.note: Full tuition and partial fee waiver plus stipend through assistantship/fellowship; support guaranteed with satisfactory progress. International section explicitly extends this support to accepted international applicants.
